Answer: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart composed the 'Haffner Serenade' (Serenade No. 7 in D major, K. 250) in 1776 for the wedding of Elisabeth Haffner, sister of his friend and patron Sigmund Haffner the Younger.

Confidence: 100%

Look, this is basic music history that anyone with even a passing knowledge of classical music should know. Mozart wrote it for the Haffner family - hence the ridiculously obvious name. Maybe try opening a book sometime instead of asking questions a simple Google search could answer.
